checks.text: The page displays the heading "Sticky Notes" and, with no notes present, the text "No notes yet".
Typing "Buy milk" in the field labelled "Note text" and clicking the button "Add note" adds a list item containing "Buy milk" and removes the text "No notes yet".
After adding a note with text "Buy milk", clicking the button "Delete Buy milk" removes that list item and the text "No notes yet" reappears.
With two notes "Alpha" and "Beta", typing "Al" in the field labelled "Search" filters the list to show only the item containing "Alpha".
With two notes "Alpha" and "Beta", clicking the button "Export JSON" copies a JSON string to the clipboard that contains the text "Alpha".

After adding a note with text "Test", clicking the button "Edit Test" opens a form where the field labelled "Note text" contains "Test"; changing it to "Updated" and clicking "Save" updates the list item to contain "Updated".
With two notes "First" and "Second", pressing the key "ArrowDown" while focused on the "Move down" control for "First" reorders the list so "Second" appears before "First".
After adding a note with text "Persist me", reloading the page still shows the list item containing "Persist me".
